title: Artificial intelligence questioned the authorship of the world's most expensive painting
hook_text: Is the world's priciest painting fake?
script:
The world's most expensive painting just faced an AI audit.
Computer scientist Atila Soares da Costa Filho used a neural network to analyze the piece.
He compared the work to other known Leonardo da Vinci paintings.
The model identified an eighty-one percent probability of student authorship.
It highlights significant differences in the painting's execution style.
The work previously sold for four hundred fifty million dollars in twenty seventeen.
The researcher claims Leonardo only intervened to finish specific parts.
This analysis suggests the painting is a collective studio effort.
Would you trust a machine to decide who painted an old masterpiece?
